map.在文本中按普通或正则规则批量替换内容，支持区分大小写、整词匹配与分组引用，适合清: Performs bulk replacements in text using literal or regex rules, with case sensitivity, whole-word matching, and capture-group references. Suitable for cleaning logs, rewriting templates, and bulk text corrections.
map.批量改写：用正则捕获组重排文本，如把「姓,名」转「名 姓」。: Bulk rewriting: rearrange text with regex capture groups, for example turning "surname,given" into "given surname".
map.数据规整：统一日期格式、替换域名、清洗噪声字符。: Data normalization: unify date formats, swap domains, strip noisy characters.
map.模板渲染：用反向引用把抽出内容填回新模板。: Template rendering: use back-references to fill extracted content into a new template.
map.：用正则「@(qq|163).com」替换为「@corp.com」，把两域名邮箱: : use the regex "@(qq|163).com" to replace with "@corp.com", unifying both domains to the corporate one; the capture group $1 can be referenced in the replacement for partial rewrites.
map.用括号分组，替换串里以 $1、$2 引用；如「([0-9]{4})-([0-9]: Group with parentheses and reference them as $1, $2 in the replacement; for example replacing "([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})" with "$2/$1" swaps month and year. Watch escaping and the global flag.
map.正则匹配范围广，建议先在小样本预览再应用到全量；涉及破坏性替换务必备份原文本。: Regexes can match very broadly, so preview on a small sample before applying to the full text; always back up the original when a replacement is destructive.
